subdomain.name: General Ledger
subdomain.capability: Immutable multi-currency double-entry bookkeeping as the authoritative financial record.
subdomain.why_distinct: Accounting language, immutability and fiscal period rules are distinct and regulated.

ubiquitous_language.definition: Classification of Assets, Liabilities, Equity, Expense and Income accounts.
Balanced set of debits and credits recording a financial transaction.
Opposite sides of a ledger posting.
Reversing journal entry used to correct prior entries.
Accounting period that can be closed to further posting.

bounded_contexts.name: Ledger Accounting
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Record and serve immutable balanced journal entries and balances.
invariants: Total Debits equal Total Credits in every journal entry
Ledger entries are immutable; corrections only via Adjustment Journal
No posting to a closed Fiscal Period
Book Balance is kept separate from Available Balance (book minus active holds)

assumptions.item: Reporting is a consumer of JournalPostedEvent but is not described.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: May become a separate supporting/generic context.

assumptions.item: Available Balance depends on holds owned by Accounts; computed here from consumed hold events.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Could move to Accounts if balance reads are needed synchronously.
